name: Level 6
tagline: Practical frameworks, real cases and decision-making for future supply chain leaders.

Plan.label: Plan
Plan.blurb: Forecast demand and agree one plan for the whole business.

Source.label: Source
Source.blurb: Choose suppliers, build good relationships and import goods.

Make.label: Make
Make.blurb: Control stock and keep quality high.

Deliver.label: Deliver
Deliver.blurb: Run the warehouse and get orders to customers on time.

Return.label: Return & sustain
Return.blurb: Manage risk, returns and sustainability, and lead the team.

sessions.title: How supply chains work
sessions.summary: What a supply chain is, how it differs from logistics, and the tools we use all course: the SCOR model, the Six Rights and FLOW.

sessions.title: Planning, forecasting and S&OP
sessions.summary: Forecast demand, measure forecast error, run Sales and Operations Planning, and see why small changes grow into the bullwhip effect.

sessions.title: Procurement and supplier relationships
sessions.summary: The procurement cycle, choosing suppliers with a weighted matrix, total cost of ownership, negotiation, and managing supplier performance.

sessions.title: International trade and global sourcing
sessions.summary: Incoterms, trade documents, customs and landed cost, freight forwarders, and how Qatar rebuilt its supply routes in 2017.

sessions.title: Inventory and stock control
sessions.summary: Stock levels, safety stock, reorder point, EOQ, ABC analysis, stock turnover and cycle counting.

sessions.title: Midterm exam
sessions.summary: Review of Sessions 1 to 5 with a revision guide, formula sheet and practice questions, then the midterm exam in class.

sessions.title: Operations, quality and continuous improvement
sessions.summary: Make-to-stock and make-to-order, quality in logistics, OTIF, Lean, PDCA and solving quality problems.

sessions.title: Warehousing and e-commerce fulfilment
sessions.summary: Warehouse layout and slotting, storage and handling equipment, picking methods, e-commerce fulfilment, safety and KPIs.

sessions.title: Transport, distribution and last mile
sessions.summary: Choosing transport modes, route planning, delivery scheduling, distribution networks, last-mile delivery and transport KPIs.

sessions.title: Risk and resilience
sessions.summary: Finding, scoring and reducing supply chain risk, with real disruptions: COVID, the Ever Given, the Red Sea and cyber attacks.

sessions.title: Leading a sustainable, digital supply chain
sessions.summary: Choosing technology, sustainability and reverse logistics, the balanced scorecard, and leading high-performing teams.

sessions.title: Final exam
sessions.summary: Review of the whole course, then the final exam in class.
